movelist.name: Meditate
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Copycat
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Copycat cannot miss.

movelist.name: Barrier
movelist.effect: The user creates a Barrier of psychic energy. The user places up to 4 segments of Barrier; each segment must be continuous with another segment, and at least one must be adjacent to the user. These barriers count as blocking terrain and last until the end of the encounter or until they are destroyed. Each Barrier segment is 2 meters tall, 1 meter wide, and 2 centimeters thick.  Each segment has 20 Hit Points, 15 Damage Reduction, and takes damage as if it was Psychic Typed.

movelist.name: Tickle
movelist.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and lower the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.effect: The Pokémon is immune to Moves with the Sonic Keyword. Defensive.
